payload.reasoning_hinge_summary: The candidate must recognize the need to calculate current (I) using Ohm's Law (I=V/R) from given circuit parameters (V, R) before applying it to the magnetic force formula (F=BIL). This bridges the 'Circuits' and 'Magnetism' topics.
payload.expected_mid_student_error: Mid-performing students might attempt to substitute voltage (V) or resistance (R) directly into the magnetic force formula (F=BIL) instead of first calculating the current (I). They may also make calculation errors like inverting Ohm's Law.
notes: The idea successfully modifies the method for finding current (from I=Q/t to I=V/R) while preserving the core schema invariant of calculating F=BIL with an inferred current.
The difficulty justification is sound, relying on conceptual linkage rather than complex arithmetic.
The proposed wrong paths are specific and target common misconceptions or calculation errors, making for effective distractors.
The visual requirement is simple and standard, posing no implementation challenges.
